speaker: right
name: Little Bunny
text: Sis! We meet again. What brings you all the way to the rats' territory?

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: Um... it just sort of happened. There was nowhere else for me to go.

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: Hmm. I guess so. Anyway, it's so dark down here that it seems dangerous. Are you okay?

speaker: right
name: Little Bunny
text: Ahaha. Sis! How can you walk around a place this dark without a lantern? I'll sell you one cheap. Take one!

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: Ugh, fine. Can't you just give it to me for free?

speaker: right
name: Little Bunny
text: Sis, I've got to make a living too!
